name: Quran in a Month
description: One Juz per day. Completes the Quran in 30 days — the classical Ramadan pace.

days.title: Juz 1 — Alif Lam Meem
days.reflection: Opens the Quran with Al-Fatiha and the early passages of Al-Baqarah on faith, guidance, and the trial of Adam.

days.title: Juz 2 — Sayaqul
days.reflection: Continues Al-Baqarah with the change of qibla and rulings on fasting, pilgrimage, and family life.

days.title: Juz 3 — Tilkal Rusul
days.reflection: Concludes Al-Baqarah with Ayat al-Kursi and moves into Aal-Imran on the People of the Book.

days.title: Juz 4 — Lan Tana Loo
days.reflection: Aal-Imran on the family of Imran and the battle of Uhud, then opens An-Nisa on justice for women and orphans.

days.title: Juz 5 — Wal Mohsanat
days.reflection: An-Nisa continues with inheritance, marriage rulings, and prayer during travel and fear.

days.title: Juz 6 — La Yuhibbullah
days.reflection: Finishes An-Nisa and opens Al-Ma'idah on covenants, dietary law, and the story of the two sons of Adam.

days.title: Juz 7 — Wa Iza Samiu
days.reflection: Al-Ma'idah completes, and Al-An'am begins with a sustained argument for tawhid against idolatry.

days.title: Juz 8 — Wa Lau Annana
days.reflection: Al-An'am on the signs of God in creation, then Al-A'raf on the stories of earlier prophets.

days.title: Juz 9 — Qadd Aflaha
days.reflection: Al-A'raf continues with Musa and Pharaoh, then Al-Anfal on the ethics of Badr.

days.title: Juz 10 — Wa A'lamu
days.reflection: Al-Anfal closes and At-Tawbah addresses treaties, hypocrisy, and community accountability.

days.title: Juz 11 — Ya'tazerun
days.reflection: At-Tawbah concludes and Yunus, Hud, and part of Yusuf recount prophets sent to their peoples.

days.title: Juz 12 — Wa Mamin Da'abat
days.reflection: Hud and Yusuf: the patience of Yaqub and the trials and rise of Yusuf in Egypt.

days.title: Juz 13 — Wa Ma Ubarri'u
days.reflection: Yusuf's reunion with his family, and Ar-Ra'd and Ibrahim on revelation and gratitude.

days.title: Juz 14 — Rubama
days.reflection: Al-Hijr and An-Nahl catalogue the natural signs of God and warn Makkan disbelievers.

days.title: Juz 15 — Subhanallazi
days.reflection: Al-Isra opens with the night journey; Al-Kahf tells of the sleepers, Musa and Khidr, and Dhul-Qarnayn.

days.title: Juz 16 — Qal Alam
days.reflection: Maryam on the births of Yahya and Isa, then Ta-Ha on Musa's mission to Pharaoh.

days.title: Juz 17 — Aqtarabath
days.reflection: Al-Anbiya on many prophets and Al-Hajj on pilgrimage and steadfastness under trial.

days.title: Juz 18 — Qadd Aflaha
days.reflection: Al-Mu'minun on the traits of true believers, An-Nur on modesty and social ethics, and Al-Furqan begins.

days.title: Juz 19 — Wa Qalallazina
days.reflection: Al-Furqan, Ash-Shu'ara, and An-Naml revisit Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Sulayman, and their peoples.

days.title: Juz 20 — A'man Khalaq
days.reflection: Al-Qasas on Musa's early life and Al-Ankabut on the trials that test faith.

days.title: Juz 21 — Utlu Ma Oohi
days.reflection: Ar-Rum, Luqman, As-Sajdah, and the opening of Al-Ahzab: wisdom, gratitude, and the trial of the Trench.

days.title: Juz 22 — Wa Manyaqnut
days.reflection: Al-Ahzab on the Prophet's household and manners, then Saba and Fatir on divine sovereignty.

days.title: Juz 23 — Wa Mali
days.reflection: Ya-Sin, As-Saffat, and Sad: resurrection, the ranks of angels, and the story of Dawud.

days.title: Juz 24 — Faman Azlam
days.reflection: Az-Zumar, Ghafir, and Fussilat on sincere worship and God's forbearance with humanity.

days.title: Juz 25 — Elahe Yuruddo
days.reflection: Ash-Shura and Az-Zukhruf on consultation and the futility of worldly ornament without faith.

days.title: Juz 26 — Ha Meem
days.reflection: Ad-Dukhan through Al-Ahqaf: the night of decree, the coming of the Hour, and warnings to the arrogant.

days.title: Juz 27 — Qala Fama Khatbukum
days.reflection: Muhammad, Al-Fath, Al-Hujurat, Qaf, and Adh-Dhariyat on victory, manners of the community, and the afterlife.

days.title: Juz 28 — Qadd Sami Allah
days.reflection: At-Tur through At-Tahrim: God's promises to the believers and the ethics of family and community.

days.title: Juz 29 — Tabaraka Allazi
days.reflection: Al-Mulk through Al-Mursalat: short, powerful surahs on sovereignty, the Day of Judgment, and the Quran itself.

days.title: Juz 30 — Amma
days.reflection: Juz Amma: the short Makkan surahs on resurrection, the mercy of God, and the return to Him.
